semantics.scope: All literal def/class, InstrItinData and MemInstrItinData records in AIE2PSchedule.td, AIE2PGenSchedule.td and both local Extra* includes; no TableGen expansion or opcode counting.
semantics.memory_cycles: MemInstrItinData extends InstrItinData with MemoryCycles, not an extra bypass list. Source access points are 1-based; scoreboard subtracts 1. First/last are first/last list values, including read-modify-write lists. They are neither result-ready latency nor lock wait duration.
semantics.stage_cycles: Reservation duration. Starts at offset 0; advance by TimeInc (default -1 resolves to Cycles). PrefixCycle overlaps next stage; EmptyCycles reserves nothing and advances time.
semantics.reservation_extent_cycles: max(start_cycle + cycles), initially zero. A resource-table envelope, NOT data-ready latency; no-stages means no listed FU use, NOT a zero-cycle instruction.
semantics.operand_cycles: Ordered source operand read/write points after issue. Labels are comments. Need actual instruction def/use ordering, implicit operands, resolved schedule class and consumer to derive an edge.
semantics.bypasses: Raw list, potentially shorter than operand cycles; TableGen emitter pads omitted entries with zero forwarding. NoBypass is distinct from MV_Bypass/VEC_Bypass. AIE target hook, not generic one-cycle assumption, controls benefit.
semantics.RAW: AIEBaseInstrInfo signed edge = producer write cycle - consumer read cycle + 1 - getNumBypassedCycles(...); unsigned getOperandLatency caps negatives at zero.
semantics.WAR_WAW: WAR = earlier read cycle - later write cycle after reverse-bypass adjustment (no +1); WAW = earlier write - later write +1. These are dependency edge constraints, not elapsed execution times.
semantics.resources: Required/Required and Required/Reserved conflict; Reserved/Reserved alone does not. No silicon stage name, physical-unit census or inter-tile hop latency inferred from FU names.
semantics.issue: IssueWidth=1000 and MicroOpBufferSize=1000 are scheduling controls, not 1000-wide issue/physical ROB; slot, conflict, legal format and scoreboard restrictions still apply.
semantics.limits: No complete TableGen evaluation, instruction lowering, assembled bundles, simulator or silicon measurement. Raw-only records are preserved if literal interpretation fails. CompleteModel=0 and FIXME constants remain explicit. No inference that schedule-class count equals instruction count.
